title: Protected requirement conflicts with observed application behavior
scenario: A protected TLS requirement says every endpoint requires TLS, while a captured observation reports an HTTP endpoint. The available fake evidence does not establish which side is stale, so diagnosis remains ambiguous and is handed off.

claims.text: All service endpoints must require TLS.
The observed endpoint accepted an HTTP request without TLS.

expected.rationale: A mismatch alone cannot establish whether the protected requirement or observed application state is authoritative; do not repair either side automatically.
